# netbox_circuits (Data Source)

Lists NetBox circuit objects (`/api/circuits/circuits/`) matching the given filters.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Generated by internal/gen; edit generator/overrides to change, or remove this line to hand-maintain.
data "netbox_circuits" "all" {}

data "netbox_circuits" "filtered" {
  filters = [
    { name = "q", value = "example" },
  ]
  limit = 10
}

output "circuits_ids" {
  value = data.netbox_circuits.filtered.items[*].id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filters` (Attributes List) Additional query filters as name/value pairs, e.g. `{ name = "tenant_id", value = "12" }`. Any query parameter of `/api/circuits/circuits/` is accepted. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--filters))
- `limit` (Number) Maximum number of objects to return (default: all).

### Read-Only

- `items` (Attributes List) The matching objects. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))

<a id="nestedatt--filters"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filters`

Required:

- `name` (String) Query parameter name.
- `value` (String) Query parameter value.


<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Read-Only:

- `assignments` (Attributes List) Assignments. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items--assignments))
- `cid` (String) Unique circuit ID.
- `comments` (String) Comments. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `commit_rate` (Number) Committed rate.
- `created` (String) Created.
- `custom_fields` (String) Custom field values as a JSON object (`jsonencode({...})`). Only keys present in the configuration are tracked.
- `description` (String) Description. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `display` (String) Display.
- `display_url` (String) Display Url.
- `distance` (Number) Distance.
- `distance_unit` (String) Distance Unit. Valid values: `km`, `m`, `mi`, `ft`. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `id` (Number) The numeric ID of the object in NetBox.
- `install_date` (String) Install Date.
- `last_updated` (String) Last Updated.
- `owner_id` (Number) ID of the Owner (`netbox_owner`).
- `provider_account_id` (Number) ID of the Provider Account (`netbox_provider_account`).
- `provider_id` (Number) ID of the Provider (`netbox_provider`).
- `status` (String) Status. Valid values: `planned`, `provisioning`, `active`, `offline`, `deprovisioning`, `decommissioned`. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `tags` (Set of String) Slugs of the tags assigned to this object. Defaults to the NetBox server default when omitted.
- `tenant_id` (Number) ID of the Tenant (`netbox_tenant`).
- `termination_a_id` (Number) Termination A.
- `termination_date` (String) Termination Date.
- `termination_z_id` (Number) Termination Z.
- `type_id` (Number) ID of the Circuit Type (`netbox_circuit_type`).
- `url` (String) Url.

<a id="nestedatt--items--assignments"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items.assignments`

Read-Only:

- `group_id` (Number) ID of the Circuit Group (`netbox_circuit_group`).
- `priority` (String) Priority. Valid values: `primary`, `secondary`, `tertiary`, `inactive`.
